lines.say: Morning! Get up. Big day.
What are we doing at the house?
Nothing! No house. Forget the house. Today, we're doing the best day of the summer.
Riot.
Every favourite thing. All of it. I've made a list!
Item one! Cannonballs! Off the tower! Bash, you're first!
Item two! Walt's four kinds of potato, on a blanket!
That was the best day I've ever had.
Yeah?
Easy. Best ever. I wouldn't change a thing.
Then why would we?
What?
I'm just saying. We've got it right here. All of this.
We could have this tomorrow, and the day after. Every day. Forever.
We don't have to finish it. Nobody's making us. We just leave the box closed.
Pip stays.
Riot.
Everyone's happy! Who's it hurting?
You've seen the snow.
I've seen the snow. I've seen what's out there, Rocco! I've seen all of it! I could have had all of it!
What do you mean, could have?
Nothing. I mean...
You dropped this. I've been holding on to it.
How long?
Since we got back. I didn't read it.
What is it?
I got a place in the city. Two and a half years ago. Full swimming scholarship.
You what?
I turned it down. I never told anyone. I told Dad I'd missed the date.
You were the fastest kid in the county.
You knew?
I noticed a letter. Then no letter. I wrote it down. I should've said.
I stayed because of you. All of you. This street.
And Grandpa's game, I thought I had to... I gave it all up, to be here.
And now if I finish it, this is gone too. Then what did I do it for?
That's the nicest thing anyone's ever done for me.
And I don't want it.
My sister's eight, and she's never seen snow. She draws the same fireflies every year.
Your dad can't remember the end of the best night of his life.
There's a whole town waiting for a thing it doesn't know it's missing.
It's not a bad summer, Riot. It's just stuck.
You'd go.
I'd go. I'd hate it. I'd miss you so much it'd change how I spent the day.
Don't keep it for me.
It was a really good day, though.
It was the best one.
Yeah.
It's still the best one. Whatever happens.
